:::{#exr-hessian-elements}
#### Entries of the Hessian

If $\vth$ is a $p \times 1$ vector,
find the dimensions of the [Hessian](#def-hessian)
$\deriv{\vth}\deriv{\vth\'}\llik$
and an expression for its $ij$th entry.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::::{.solution}

$\deriv{\vth\'}\llik$ is the $1 \times p$ row vector
whose $j$th entry is $\deriv{\th_j}\llik$.
Differentiating each entry with respect to the $p \times 1$ vector $\vth$
gives a $p \times 1$ column of derivatives per entry,
so $\deriv{\vth}\deriv{\vth\'}\llik$ is $p \times p$,
with $ij$th entry $\deriv{\th_i}\deriv{\th_j}\llik$.

::::
